# PepPlotter - Full Technical & Mathematical Documentation

> PepPlotter is a high-precision visual peptide reconstitution calculator and multi-dose pharmacokinetic (PK) simulator.

## Mathematical Algorithms

### 1. Reconstitution Concentration
- Concentration (mg/mL) = Vial Quantity (mg) / Bacteriostatic Water Volume (mL)
- Concentration (mcg/mL) = Concentration (mg/mL) * 1000

### 2. Syringe Draw Volume & Units
- Injection Volume (mL) = Target Dose (mg) / Concentration (mg/mL)
- U-100 Insulin Syringe Units = Injection Volume (mL) * 100
- U-40 Syringe Units = Injection Volume (mL) * 40

### 3. Pharmacokinetic Exponential Decay & Multi-Dose Superposition
For any given dose D_i administered at time t_i:
- Elimination Rate Constant: k_e = ln(2) / half_life
- Concentration Contribution: C_i(t) = (D_i / V_d) * exp(-k_e * (t - t_i)) for t >= t_i
- Total Serum Concentration at time t: C_total(t) = Sum_{i, t >= t_i} C_i(t)
- Steady-State Accumulation Factor: R = 1 / (1 - exp(-k_e * tau)), where tau is dosing interval.

## Clinical Safety & Harm Reduction
- Subcutaneous injection angle: 90 degrees for standard 5/16" (8mm) or 1/2" (12.7mm) insulin needles; 45 degrees if pinching minimal subcutaneous fat.
- Aseptic procedure: 70% Isopropyl alcohol swab, allow 15 seconds to air dry.
- Site rotation: Left abdomen, right abdomen, outer upper thigh, upper arm to prevent lipohypertrophy.
- Reconstitution technique: Slowly run BAC water down inside glass wall. Swirl gently; do not shake violently to avoid protein denaturation.
